column3: With respect to the ExchangeRight 71 Mortgage Loan (3.9%), with respect to the following Mortgaged Properties, the related single tenant has a ROFR to purchase the Mortgaged Property if the borrower receives an offer as to such Mortgaged Property that it is otherwise willing to accept: (i) Natural Grocers - Independence and (ii) Natural Grocers - Vancouver. Each related ROFR is not extinguished by foreclosure; however, the ROFR does not apply to foreclosure or deed-in-lieu thereof.
